facts.fact: The report states the Ministry of Health, with WHO technical support, produced and launched the Health Statistics Abstract (2025) at the Fourth South Sudan Health Summit, 2-5 December 2025, launched by the Vice President.

note: Only the Health Statistics Abstract launch is a fact; no civil-registration vital statistics report is stated (Trends in Deaths by Cause is not said to come from civil registration); DHIS2 audit and EWARS linkage are an information system with no product named.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health, with the National Bureau of Statistics, published the inaugural 2025 Health Statistics Abstract covering 2021 to 2024, drawing routine facility data from DHIS2 alongside surveys and modelled estimates; the document gives no release date beyond its 2025 publication year, so the published date is used.

systems.country_label: Republic of South Sudan 2025 Health Statistics Abstract
systems.owner: Ministry of Health; National Bureau of Statistics

note: No vital statistics report: the abstract says CRVS remains underdeveloped and most indicators are modelled estimates, so nothing is recorded for vital or series.
The document says nothing on statistics from administrative records.
A labour force survey pre-test, not statistics from administrative records.

facts.fact: The Ministry of General Education and Instruction's National Education Census Report 2023, drawn from the Annual Education Census of schools (enrolment, teachers, facilities) under its Education Management Information System, was published with data kept in a web-based repository; date is the document's published date (2023-01-01, a proxy), not the year its figures cover.

The Foreword calls the Annual Education Census an annual action under the Education Management Information System that has consistently provided school data and statistics; date is the report's published date (2023-01-01, a proxy).
facts.system: Annual Education Census (National Education Census Report 2023)
